name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, a little wider than your shoulders. Keep your arms straight and your shoulders active.
Bend your knees and raise them toward your chest. At the top, curl your pelvis up a little. Do not swing.
Lower your legs slowly until they hang straight down again.
Repeat for the set number of repetitions. If your grip fails first, use straps or a captain's chair.
